queries_run: Honeywell market share gaining OR losing competitor 2026
Honeywell Aerospace OR Building Automation competitor design win 2026

findings.claim: HON 10-K 列出各事業主要對手（航太：Garmin、L3Harris、Rolls Royce、RTX、Safran、Thales；樓宇：Johnson Controls、Schneider、Siemens；工業自動化：Emerson、Rockwell 等），並把新進入者與產品商品化列為可能造成市占下降、價格與毛利下滑的風險。
findings.excerpt: changes in the competitive landscape, including new market entrants and new technologies that may lead to product commoditization, and adverse industry economic conditions, all of which could result in lower market share, reduced selling prices, and lower margins.

findings.claim: 10-K 稱公司須在對手數量不斷增加（含許多新進與非傳統對手）的情況下守住市占。
findings.excerpt: defend our market share against an ever-expanding number of competitors, including many new and non-traditional competitors
